discovery_notes: B409 follow-up 9 of B044 (DLP 2020-2021), 27 web searches, all search_snippet. New: Little Mermaid event 2021 Ariel in Shell, Vanessa, Ariel and Ursula, Ariel Contract (LE 425, EUR 17); Guardians of the Galaxy OE 19 Jun 2021 logo and Rocket (two Groot unrecorded); MINIS Feb 2021 four (held); Snow White Oct 2021 eight more (each dwarf plus Snow White and Prince Charming). Resolved: Sorcier jumbo 20 Nov 2021 Pueblo Trading Post; Oct 2020 LE sales identified; Dec 2020 cancelled LE = July 2021 LE four. Floats, RotJ, Dalmatians LE still missing.
